contractLaneGate.brokenContract: After the generated-message fallback became journal-backed, the 60-second deferred maintenance policy could still rewrite both large message primaries while holding the global write gate. A new Roleplay user-message create then waited for that maintenance to finish.
contractLaneGate.impliedContract: Background maintenance must not block foreground message acknowledgement for tens of seconds.
contractLaneGate.actualEnforcement: FlushKind::Deferred excludes messages and message-swipes. FlushKind::Shutdown and every explicit replacement path continue through the existing validated materialization boundary.
contractLaneGate.primaryOwnerDetail: FileStorage owns journal acknowledgement, deferred compaction selection, shutdown flush, and startup recovery.
contractLaneGate.wrongLaneFixToAvoid: Do not hide the delay in UI state, skip durable writes, weaken journal sync, or change provider and memory behavior.
